title: docs(spec): record:line_items columns hydrate from the child field, like the master-detail carriers
body:
Fixes #24140

Clause-②: no

The spec half of route B from the triage grade (comment 6229394877): `record:line_items` `columns` now says that the block hydrates an identity-only column from the child object's field, as the master-detail carriers do. The heading of an identity-only column is then the child field's label, and it translates with that label. This change adds no key and changes no accept/reject result. The renderer half is objectstack-ai/objectui#12854 (its `Blocked-by:` names this card).

## What changed

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, `RecordLineItemsProps.columns` describe.** Before, it said "this block does NOT hydrate a column from the child object's field: declare `label`, `type` and `options` yourself". It now states the carriers' rule in the carriers' words: "identity-only entries ({ name }) hydrate everything else from the child object's fields, `label`, `type` and `options` included, so an identity-only column is headed by the child field's label and translates with it". It also states the opt-out in `InlineGridColumnSchema.type`'s words: "Declaring `type` opts a column out of hydration — supply its `label`, `options` and other extras yourself". The "Required, with at least one column" sentence is kept.
- **The same file, `RecordLineItemsProps` TSDoc.** The paragraph that explained the old difference is rewritten. It now says that the column means what it means on the carriers, because `InlineGridColumnSchema.label`'s own describe governs every carrier. It names the renderer half (`LineItemsPanel` reusing `hydrateColumns`, not a second resolver). It also says that until the `.objectui-sha` pin carries that half, an identity-only column still draws as a text cell headed by its name. Last, it says that `defineStack`'s resolved-type check (`collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors`) walks only the three master-detail carriers. One phrase moved in the presence paragraph: "draws `columns` as given" became "draws only the authored `columns`". The column set is still never derived here.
- **`content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`.** Regenerated by `gen:docs`: one table row changed. `check:generated` named only this artifact as stale.
- **`.changeset/24140-line-items-columns-hydrate.md`.** `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, because the describe text ships in `dist` and in the JSON Schema.

`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` is untouched. `InlineGridColumnSchema.label` ("defaults to the child field's label via hydration") and `type` ("Declaring it opts the column out of schema hydration") were false for this one block. After this change they are true for every carrier, so they do not need to name `record:line_items`.

## Measured before editing (origin/main cb8756b00)

- **H1, the premise holds.** `component.zod.ts:2494` carried the "does NOT hydrate" describe, and `field.zod.ts:971`/`:972` carried the hydration describes. On the renderer side, objectui main `26323c4` `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx` hands `applyColumnPermissions(schema.columns, …)` to the grid. A grep for `hydrate` in that file returns zero hits. Control: the same grep finds `hydrateColumns` in `deriveMasterDetail.ts`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and their tests.
- **H2, the wording.** The carriers' describe (`inlineColumns`, and `columns` on an `object-master-detail-form` detail entry) is "identity-only entries ({ name }) hydrate everything else from the child object's fields". objectui `hydrateColumns` (`deriveMasterDetail.ts`, objectui `26323c4`) hydrates a column only when it declares no `type`, and it keeps an authored `label`. It fills `label`, `type`, `required`, `options`, the lookup target, the file props, `readonlyWhen`/`requiredWhen` and a computed `expr`. The new describe reuses the carriers' sentence and names the three keys the card names. It adds no narrower or wider rule.
- **H3, the liveness ledger.** A case-insensitive grep for `line_items` in `packages/spec/liveness/` hits only `page.json:57` and `view.json:351`. In the `page.json` row `regions`, entry [15] cites `columns L#gridField (applyColumnPermissions)`. That is a read point, not a quote of the old describe. No row quotes "does NOT hydrate", so the ledger is unchanged. Control: `related_list` hits twice each in `field.json` and `page.json`. The `field.json` inline-column rows (`inlineColumns`, lines 410-423) cite `hydrateColumns`, which stays true.
- **H5, other statements of the old behaviour.** Hand-written `content/docs/**` (outside `references/` and `releases/`) contains no sentence about line-items hydration. Positive control: the same grep finds `record:line_items` in `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx`, and `layout-dsl.mdx:788` states the carriers' rule for `object-master-detail-form`. `packages/lint` has no rule that prescribes or enforces a `label` on these columns. `validate-field-consumers.ts:392` says the block "derives nothing", which is about the column set and stays true. The `skills/**` and `examples/**` hits are listed under Acceptance notes and were not edited.

## H4: accept/reject unchanged, measured on the built package

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` ran at the base cb8756b00 and again at a66b47182. The script compares every JSON Schema with `description` removed and lists the description paths that changed:
  - `ui/RecordLineItemsProps.json`: structure identical once descriptions are removed; one description path changed, `/properties/columns`.
  - `objectstack.json`: structure identical once descriptions are removed; one description path changed, `/$defs/ui/RecordLineItemsProps/properties/columns`.
  - Every other schema file is byte-identical. The only other file that differs is `.build-input-hash-schema`.
  - Control for the instrument: comparing `RecordHistoryProps.json` against `RecordLineItemsProps.json` reports structure `False`, so the comparison can fail.
- `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` is byte-identical before and after the build.
- `inline-grid-column-carriers.test.ts` passes unchanged, including the line-items section. Its test "CONTROL — defineStack does not judge an identity-only line-items column" still asserts that `build()` accepts `{ name: 'amount', scale: 2 }` over a currency child field on `record:line_items` and refuses the same column under `object-master-detail-form`.

- 101 exit 0. Six of them first refused with exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and were re-run after the prerequisite was met:
  - The closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' --filter '@objectstack/formula...' run build` unblocked `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure`.

## Acceptance notes

1. **`defineStack`'s resolved-type check does not reach `record:line_items`.** `collectHydratedInlineColumnErrors` (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) judges "inline grid columns whose TYPE comes from the child field" on three carriers. Once the renderer half lands, an identity-only `record:line_items` column takes its type from the child field too. A `{ name: 'amount', scale: 2 }` column over a `currency` field will then publish green on this block and be reported only at render time, while `object-master-detail-form` refuses the same column at publish. Bringing the block into that check changes what publishes, so it is out of this Clause-② `no` card. It is reported for a separate card that depends on objectstack-ai/objectui#12854. The carriers test's CONTROL title ("the panel draws it unhydrated") describes the pinned renderer, and it flips with that card.
2. **The transition window.** Until objectstack-ai/objectui#12854 lands and the `.objectui-sha` pin carries it, an identity-only `record:line_items` column still draws as a text cell headed by its field name. The TSDoc and the changeset both say this. The pin bump that carries objectui#12854 should delete the TSDoc sentence that begins "Until the `.objectui-sha` pin carries it".
3. **Showcase invoice page (held off).** The comment above the columns in `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/invoice-document.page.ts` (around lines 59-66) still states the old behaviour, and so does the docblock of `examples/app-showcase/test/invoice-document-line-items.test.ts` (lines 12-15). These belong to the showcase invoice card (#23985): its PR decides whether to drop the literal labels.
4. **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md:112-113` (Tier H, not edited).** The print-page example writes identity-only `record:line_items` columns (`{ name: 'product' }`, …). That matches the new contract. Before objectui#12854 lands, those columns print raw field names.
5. **`main` moved while this was open.** `main` gained #24170 (the `record:json` retirement), which edits `component.zod.ts` at `:458` and `:2571` and removes the `record:json` section of `component.mdx` (lines 1793-1805). Neither touches this diff's hunks, so `main` was not merged in, per the dispatch's merge-on-conflict-only instruction. The PR's CI and the merge queue validate the merge.
